title: Single-chart conversion for the previous quotient model
statement: Let the data and a bounded finite-projective complex P over E=A/I^(n+1) be as in the previous-model construction, and let a chart Z→W→V carry the supplied comparison isomorphism with the canonical representative. Then there exists a cochain complex Q of B=A/I^(n+2)-modules, supported in [a,b] with finite terms, whose constant realization over φ_{n+1} has, in every degree, the same slice homology as the explicit previous object E_n.

source.place: Tags 0942, 094H and 094I, exact realization on the previous-model cover.

proof.text: Define Q by restriction of scalars along the quotient A/I^(n+2) → A/I^(n+1). The homological-complex restriction functor preserves strict support bounds, and finiteness follows from the finite quotient datum together with finite generation of each P.X i.
Apply the chartwise homology transport theorem to the supplied comparison isomorphism e, yielding the required degreewise slice homology isomorphisms for Q.

theorem finiteQuotient_previous_local_complexes_chart
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n))
    (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (V : X.Etale) (W Z : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V) (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) ℤ)
    (ha : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hfinite : ∀ i : ℤ,
      Module.Projective (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) (P.X i) ∧
        Module.Finite (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) (P.X i))
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d n).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ n)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X _ P))))) :
    ∃ Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))) ℤ,
      Q.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ Q.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (Q.X i)) ∧
        ∀ q : ℤ, Nonempty
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                (finiteQuotientPreviousObject X d M n)) ≅
            (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
              ((finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X
                (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (φ (n + 1))).obj (Q.homology q)))
